text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Spain's Foreign Minister Abel Matutes visits Algeria for talks with Algerian officials on cooperation between the two countries.
- Rally for Democracy and Culture (RCD) party to boycott national conference which will be convened on Saturday and Sunday.
- The RCD accuses "shadowy groups" within the authorities for backtracking on agreed reforms including the recognition of the Berber language as an official language alongside Arabic.
- The national conference risks to be merely a show meeting after the RCD announced its boycott.
